title: Screening for Glaucoma in Namil Area, South Korea
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to study the prevalence of glaucoma in Korea, the investigators selected Namil area in Geumsan city, located in central Korea. The residents aged over 40 in this area are to be recruited to full ophthalmologic examination to detect and classify the glaucoma.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All residents aged over 40 in Namil area

Exclusion Criteria:

* Individuals registered but not actually living in this area
study_population: All residents aged over 40 in Namil area in Geumsan city
